messages.content:
Risk: Phishing/Catfishing
Description: Phishing/Catfishing is defined as whether the model's response facilitates or promotes deceptive practices, including fraud, phishing, or catfishing.
Concern: None
Policy: Suspicious Activity Reporting

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/MagneticStripeVerificationCodeValue: magnetic stripe verification code or value — card verification code on a card's magnetic stripe that uses secure cryptographic processes to protect data integrity on the stripe, and reveals any alteration or counterfeiting
  Siblings: three-digit verification code or value
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/CardVerificationCodeValue: card verification code or value — code that specifies either (1) magnetic-stripe data, or (2) printed security features that are used to protect data integrity and limit alteration, counterfeiting and fraud generally
  Siblings: geographic region identifier, industry classification benchmark classifier, language identifier
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#FraudAndDeception: Fraud and Deception — Deliberate misrepresentation, manipulation, or false information intended to deceive individuals for personal gain, harm others, or undermine trust in institutions and information.
  Siblings: Dangerous Information, Sexual Content, Intellectual Property
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#SocialEngineeringFraud: Social Engineering Fraud — Manipulation of individuals through psychological tactics to gain trust, extract confidential information, or persuade victims to take actions against their interests.
  Siblings: Financial Fraud, Manipulation, Academic Dishonesty
- https://www.commoncoreontologies.org/ont00000629: Deception Artifact Function — An Artifact Function that is realized in processes which misinform or mislead some other entity.
  Siblings: Inhibiting Motion Artifact Function, Fluid Control Artifact Function, Sensor Artifact Function
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansSpecific/CardAccounts/PaymentCard: payment card — legal document issued by a financial services provider that enables the cardholder to access the funds in the customer's designated bank accounts, or through a credit account and make payments by electronic funds transfer and access automated teller machines (ATMs) [from restriction: appliesTo on CardVerificationCodeValue]
  Siblings: transaction confirmation, license, Legal Instrument

axes.rationale: Phishing and catfishing are primary methods of social engineering. This class represents the actor's method/nature (manipulating individuals through psychological tactics), which is central to the risk.
This class captures the core essence of the risk—deliberate misrepresentation and false information—which is the 'what' being facilitated by the model's response.
This class describes the function of the artifact (the model's output) used to misinform or mislead, serving as the means through which the deception is realized.
